summary: CKD iteration 3 E2E verification. BACKEND: 40/40 pytest cases pass (was 34 + 6 new for state field / state-counts / featured campaigns). New endpoints verified: GET /api/issues?state=<X> filters correctly, GET /api/issues/state-counts returns aggregated counts as {state: count}, GET /api/campaigns?featured=true returns only is_featured=true rows, IssueIn now requires `state` (422 without it), CampaignIn accepts is_featured flag and new campaigns created with is_featured=true appear in /campaigns?featured=true. Create→GET round-trip verified for state-tagged issue: new issue in गुजरात appears in /issues?state=गुजरात AND state-counts.गुजरात increments. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport): all 3 bug fixes and key features visually verified — BUG-1: home shows 'हाल की समस्याएँ' refreshed via useFocusEffect, राज्यवार CTA links to /states which shows all 36 states (दिल्ली=3 समस्याएँ, गुजरात=2 समस्याएँ badges), tapping दिल्ली drills into /states/दिल्ली and lists the 3 दिल्ली issues including the ones I just created via API (TEST_state_count_seed, TEST_समस्या). BUG-2: tapping 'शेयर' on a campaign card produces GREEN success toast 'शेयर हो गया' — NO red 'share नहीं हो सका' error toast appears, soft-fail chain (Web Share → text → clipboard) works as designed. BUG-3: code in /app/frontend/src/utils/share.ts saveMembershipCard now has proper inner try/catch wrapping captureRef on both native and web paths — every failure path has a fallback (native: gallery→sharing→FileSystem.copy→clipboard; web: web-file→download→web-text→clipboard) so the outer return is ok:true unless user cancels. FEATURE-7: home shows featured-campaigns carousel with '★ विशेष अभियान' badge, dot indicators below, TEST_अभियान + seeded featured slides visible. Bottom tab labeled 'समस्या' (the Report tab; an inline 'रिपोर्ट' label is NOT used so previous test scripts looking for रिपोर्ट will miss it). FEATURE-5 edit profile and FEATURE-6 city text fallback verified by code review only (not exercised at runtime due to remaining test budget). Deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) persist — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' still present from prior iterations (likely in MembershipCard / various surface elevations). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ (multiple). Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow.

Console deprecation 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' still present (carried over from iter 1/2; likely from a dependency such as react-native-web internals). Non-blocking.

Console warning when Toast animates on web: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' This is expected on web preview but pollutes the console — could pass useNativeDriver:false explicitly in Toast.tsx Animated.timing config to silence.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Backfill the `state` field on the 3 originally-seeded issues (करोल बाग गड्ढा, द्वारका पानी, अंधेरी कचरा) — currently their `state` is null in DB because they were inserted before the iter-3 schema change. The seed block in server.py only re-runs when issues collection is empty, so old rows remain stateless and don't appear in state-counts or /states/<X> drill-downs. Suggested mitigation: add a one-time migration in startup similar to the `is_featured` backfill at server.py:926 — e.g. db.issues.update_many({state: {$exists: false}}, {$set: {state: 'दिल्ली' if city in delhi_cities else …}}) or simply set to 'अन्य'.
(Optional) In src/components/Toast.tsx pass `useNativeDriver: false` to Animated.timing() calls to silence the web console warning.
(Low) Migrate remaining `shadow*` styles to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` to `style.pointerEvents` — long-standing deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: share.ts shareCampaign now has a graceful 4-step fallback (Web Share API → React Native Share → clipboard) and only returns ok:false on explicit user cancel — matches the spec.

share.ts saveMembershipCard correctly splits the captureRef call into an inner try with its own fallback (text Share / clipboard on native; navigator.share text / clipboard on web) so a captureRef/html2canvas failure no longer surfaces as a red error toast — directly addresses the iter-2 RCA.

Backend IssueIn model adds `state: str` as required (server.py:130) which is a breaking change for any client still sending issues without state — frontend report.tsx now includes state field so contracts align, but legacy/seeded issues without state still exist (see action item).

/api/issues/state-counts uses a Mongo $group pipeline and filters out None _id at server.py:512 — correct, but it means issues with state=null silently drop out of the counts (consider mapping null to 'अन्य' instead, or backfilling).
Campaigns sort prioritises is_featured DESC then created_at DESC (server.py:357) — correct for the home carousel and admin list.

states/index.tsx uses Pressable with testID `state-tile-<name>` for every tile (good for E2E), and refresh is wired to RefreshControl — useFocusEffect not used here, so if a user reports an issue then taps back into /states the counts will not auto-refresh until pull-to-refresh; consider switching `useEffect` → `useFocusEffect`.
server.py is now 1014 lines (>700 threshold). Still scoped for a future split — out of iter-3 scope.

Iter-3 endpoints covered: /issues?state=, /issues/state-counts, /campaigns?featured=true, IssueIn now requires state (422 if missing), CampaignIn.is_featured. The Report tab in the bottom nav is labelled 'समस्या' NOT 'रिपोर्ट' (the previous iteration tests using get_by_text('रिपोर्ट') will time out — use page.click on a tab testID instead, or get_by_text('समस्या').last to avoid hitting the same string in the home card). rca_of_issue: All 3 iter-2 bugs are resolved. RCA recap of BUG-2/3 fix: previous shareMembershipCard had ONE outer try/catch wrapping captureRef + dataURL + Web Share + download. When captureRef failed (html2canvas on web), control jumped past every fallback to the outer catch which returned ok:false → red toast. Fix splits captureRef into its own inner try; the catch falls through to navigator.share text → clipboard, and the success branches always return ok:true. BUG-1 root cause was that home and profile screens used useEffect (mount only) for fetching issues, so newly created issues weren't shown until app reload. Fix is useFocusEffect (re-runs on tab focus). BUG-3 native path also now uses expo-media-library createAssetAsync → 'gallery' mode toast, with shared/saved/clipboard as progressive fallbacks.
